resources.string: Remembered separately for each theme. Switching themes automatically applies its page-turn mode.
Fixed to continuous scrolling; the page-turn mode cannot be changed. Uses a single HTML with no distinction between first and continuation pages.

Scroll templates use format version 2 with type set to scroll; only scrollHtml, CSS and JavaScript are edited. The whole chapter has exactly one data-reader-page=\"scroll\" and one natural-height data-reader-flow=\"body\" body area. You can place the body inside a fixed-height data-reader-scroll-viewport container so only the central reading frame scrolls while headers and footers stay fixed; without the container the whole chapter scrolls with the page.

Page templates are always used in EPUB mode for regular content. Colors, fonts, font size, spacing, headers and footers are all set in the template; the original reading styles and their settings entries are hidden. Paged templates can design the first page and continuation pages separately; scroll templates use one continuous HTML with the page-turn mode fixed to scrolling. Highlights are added to the body before layout is measured, and paragraph-comment bubbles are preserved.
Import page template or standalone backup

\"Export file\" shares one template; \"Standalone backup\" saves the template library and the hidden state of built-in templates. Both can be imported from a file. The template library is not included in regular backups. Imports are merged; different content with the same ID is saved as a copy.

HTML, CSS and JavaScript are saved as-is; tags and styles are not filtered. Saving only checks the template format; runtime errors are shown in the preview or chapter content.

JavaScript global object: readerTemplate.
source: editable body DOM; fields: dynamic info; viewport: viewport info.
Use readerTemplate.on(event, handler) to listen for beforeLayout, beforePage, afterPage, afterLayout, pageChange, fieldsChange, motionChange and dispose; the return value cancels the listener.
Modify the body in beforeLayout and set the body area in beforePage. afterLayout provides the candidate pages for this pass; pageChange reports navigation; motionChange reports the committed current page and actual state, and also fires on first display and re-pagination.
Limited async preparation: readerTemplate.waitUntil(promise); request re-pagination: readerTemplate.requestLayout(). Do not wait for infinite animations or unconditionally re-layout inside pagination hooks.
motionChange state is settled, running or paused and does not await the returned Promise. Use it to start and pause JS animations; keep a full static frame when settled. Release old tasks on page changes and clear timers, events and requests on dispose. HTML, CSS and JS can all be rewritten freely; the daylight-roaming demo uses JS to control the nine-slot inventory, the walking character and day/night; mark paragraphs before pagination so effects only apply to decorations. fieldsChange accepts a third argument {fields: ["time"]} to subscribe to time only.

Body area: data-reader-flow="body". Multiple areas can be placed and content flows in DOM order or by data-reader-order.
Dynamic info: data-reader-field="chapterTitle|bookName|time|battery|page|pageIndex|pageCount|progress"; each element selects one field.
Page root: data-reader-page="first|other". Body paragraphs and chapter titles: .reader-paragraph, .reader-chapter-title.
Style variables: --reader-text-color, --reader-page-background, --reader-accent, --reader-font-size, --reader-line-height, --reader-paragraph-indent, --reader-paragraph-spacing.
